ps3.4:1.2: ‘seyyathāpi bhikkhave, ye keci balakaraṇīyā kammantā karīyanti, sabbe te paṭhaviṃ nissāya paṭhaviyaṃ patiṭṭhāya evamete balakaraṇīyā kammantā karīyanti.
ps3.4:1.3: evameva bhikkhave’ bhikkhu sīlaṃ nissāya sīle patiṭṭhāya ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bhāveti, ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bahulīkaroti.
ps3.4:2.1: kathañca bhikkhave bhikkhu sīlaṃ nissāya sīle patiṭṭhāya ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bhāveti, ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bahulīkaroti:
ps3.4:2.2: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu sammādiṭṭhiṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ.
ps3.4:2.9: sammāsamādhiṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggaparināmi.
ps3.4:2.10: evaṃ kho bhikkhave, bhikkhu sīlaṃ nissāya sīle patiṭṭhāya ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bhāveti, ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bahulīkaroti.”
ps3.4:3.1: “seyyathāpi bhikkhave, ye keci me bījagāmabhūtagāmā vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjati, sabbe te paṭhaviṃ nissāya paṭhaviyaṃ patiṭṭhāya evamete khijagāmabhūtagāmā vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjatanti.
ps3.4:3.2: evameva kho bhikkhave, bhikkhu sīlaṃ nissāya sīle patiṭṭhāya ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bhāvento ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bahulīkaronto vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ pāpuṇāti dhammesu.
ps3.4:4.1: kathañca bhikkhave, bhikkhu sīlaṃ nissāya sīle patiṭṭhāya ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bhāvento, ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bahulīkaronto: vuddhi virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ pāpuṇāti dhammesu:
ps3.4:4.2: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu sammādiṭṭhiṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ,
ps3.4:4.9: sammāsamādhiṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ.
ps3.4:4.10: evaṃ kho bhikkhave, bhikkhu sīlaṃ nissāya sīle patiṭṭhāya ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bhāvento, ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bahulīkaronto vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ pāpuṇāti dhammesū’ti.
ps3.4:5.1: sammādiṭṭhiyā pañca vivekā, pañca virāgā, pañca nirodhā, pañca vossaggā, dvādasa nissayā.
ps3.4:5.8: sammāsamādhissa pañca vivekā, pañca virāgā, pañca nirodhā, pañca vossaggā, dvādasa nissayā.
ps3.4:6.3: vikkhambhanaviveko ca nīvaraṇānaṃ, paṭhamajjhānaṃ bhāvayato. tadaṅgaviveko ca diṭṭhigatānaṃ nibbedhabhāgiyaṃ samādhiṃ bhāvayato, samucchedaviveko ca lokuttaraṃ khayagāmī maggaṃ bhāvayato, paṭippassasaddhiviveko ca phalakkhaṇe, nissaraṇaviveko ca nirodho nibbānaṃ.
ps3.4:6.5: imesu pañcasu vivekesu chandajāto hoti saddhādhimutto, cittaṃ cassa svādhiṭṭhitaṃ.
ps3.4:7.3: vikkhambhanavirāgo ca nīvaraṇānaṃ, paṭhamajjhānaṃ bhāvayato. tadaṅgavirāgo ca diṭṭhigatānaṃ nibbedhabhāgiyaṃ samādhiṃ bhāvayato, samucchedavirāgo ca lokuttaraṃ khayagāmīmaggaṃ bhāvayato, paṭippassasaddhivirāgo ca phalakkhaṇe, nissaraṇavirāgo ca nirodho nibbānaṃ.
ps3.4:7.5: imesu pañcasu virāgesu chandajāto hoti saddhādhimutto, cittañcassa svādhiṭṭhitaṃ.
ps3.4:8.3: vikkhambhananirodho ca nīvaraṇānaṃ paṭhamajjhānaṃ bhāvayato. tadaṅganirodho ca diṭṭhigatānaṃ nibbedhabhāgiyaṃ samādhiṃ bhāvayato, samucchedanirodho ca lokuttaraṃ khayagāmīmaggaṃ bhāvayato, paṭippassasaddhinirodho ca phalakkhaṇe, nissaraṇanirodho ca amatā dhātu,
ps3.4:8.5: imesu pañcasu nirose chandajāto hoti saddhādhimutto, cittaṃ cassa svādhiṭṭhitaṃ.
ps3.4:9.3: vikkhambhanavossaggo ca nīvaraṇānaṃ, paṭhamajjhānaṃ bhāvayato. tadaṅgavossaggo ca diṭṭhigatānaṃ nibbedhabhāgiyaṃ samādhiṃ bhāvayato, samucchedavossaggo ca lokuttaraṃ khayagāmīmaggaṃ bhāvayato, paṭippassasaddhivossaggo ca phalakkhaṇe, nissaraṇavossaggo ca nirodho nibbānaṃ.
ps3.4:9.5: imesu pañcasu vossaggesu chandajāto hoti saddhādhimutto. cittañcassa svādhiṭṭhitaṃ.
ps3.4:9.6: sammādiṭṭhiyā ime pañca vivekā, pañcavirāgā, pañca nirodhā, pañca vossaggā, dvāsada nissayā.
ps3.4:10.9: vikkhambhanaviveko ca nīvaraṇānaṃ paṭhamajjhānaṃ bhāvayato, tadaṅgaviveko ca diṭṭhigatānaṃ nibbedhabhāgiyaṃ samādhiṃ bhāvayato, samucchedaviveko ca lokuttaraṃ khayagāmīmaggaṃ bhāvayato, paṭippassaddhiviveko ca phalakkhaṇe, nissaraṇaviveko ca nirodhaṃ nibbānaṃ,
ps3.4:10.11: imesu pañcasu vivekesu chandajāto hoti saddhādhimutto, cittañcassa svādhiṭṭhitaṃ.

ps3.4:11.5: imesu pañcasu virāgesu chandajāto hoti saddhādhimutto cittañcassa svādhiṭṭhitaṃ.

ps3.4:12.5: imesu pañcasu nirodhesu chandajāto hoti saddhādhimutto, cittañcassa svādhiṭṭhitaṃ.
